source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The V3 mail-tab test now changes sort type/order, pane visibility, layout, and every grouping switch sequence. It checks both API output and real about:3pane view-wrapper or preference state through named checkRealSort, checkRealLayout, and checkRealView messages. Current test retains those checks. When an extension API changes a visible mail tab property, test the native state as well as the returned object, including changes back to prior grouping modes.
title: Mail tab update tests verify API results and underlying view state across transitions
